{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data sentinel)
valid_ages = data[data['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute and print the number of valid ages
num_valid_ages = len(valid_ages)
print(f"Number of valid customer_age entries: {num_valid_ages}")

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()
print(f"Mean age of customers (excluding -1 sentinels): {mean_age}")

# Round to two decimal places for final answer
rounded_mean_age = round(mean_age, 2)
print(f"Rounded mean age: {rounded_mean_age}")"}
